Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You lay out the bargain, then leave space for the answer. The first objection tells you where the real negotiation begins.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time

One willing negotiating partner who can understand you.
Type
Skill

Make a Guile roll toward the concession you seek.

Weak
2 progress.
Standard

Strong
